messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that creates a comprehensive sorting algorithms visualizer.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Implement 5 sorting algorithms: Bubble, Quick, Merge, Heap, Radix
- Visual bars with color coding: red (comparing), yellow (swapping), green (sorted), blue (pivot)
- Algorithm selection dropdown and speed control slider
- Toggle between step-by-step and continuous modes
- Real-time complexity analysis display (O-notation)
- Scramble button with patterns: Random, Reverse, Nearly Sorted
- Call stack depth visualization for recursive algorithms
- Real-time comparison and swap counters
- Working area highlighting for divide-and-conquer
- Smooth 60 FPS performance, no external libraries

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

function initSortingVisualizer(canvasId){const canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);if(!canvas)return;canvas.width=500;canvas.height=500;const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');const BAR_COUNT=100;let data=new Array(BAR_COUNT).fill(0).map(()=>Math.random());let speed=50;let stepMode=false;let pauseNext=false;let algorithm='Bubble';const complexities={Bubble:'O(n²)',Quick:'O(n log n)',Merge:'O(n log n)',Heap:'O(n log n)',Radix:'O(k·n)'};let comparisons=0,swaps=0,callDepth=0;const ui=document.createElement('div');ui.style.fontFamily='sans-serif';ui.style.marginTop='10px';document.body.appendChild(ui);const algoSelect=document.createElement('select');['Bubble','Quick','Merge','Heap','Radix'].forEach(a=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=a;o.textContent=a;algoSelect.appendChild(o);});ui.appendChild(algoSelect);ui.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Algorithm '));const speedSlider=document.createElement('input');speedSlider.type='range';speedSlider.min='10';speedSlider.max='200';speedSlider.value='50';ui.appendChild(speedSlider);ui.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Speed '));const stepChk=document.createElement('input');stepChk.type='checkbox';ui.appendChild(stepChk);ui.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Step-by-step '));const nextBtn=document.createElement('button');nextBtn.textContent='Next';nextBtn.disabled=true;ui.appendChild(nextBtn);ui.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' Scramble '));const scrambleSelect=document.createElement('select');['Random','Reverse','Nearly Sorted'].forEach(p=>{const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=p;o.textContent=p;scrambleSelect.appendChild(o);});ui.appendChild(scrambleSelect);const scrambleBtn=document.createElement('button');scrambleBtn.textContent='Scramble';ui.appendChild(scrambleBtn);ui.appendChild(document.createElement('br'));const info=document.createElement('div');info.style.marginTop='5px';ui.appendChild(info);function draw(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);const w=canvas.width/BAR_COUNT;for(let i=0;i<BAR_COUNT;i++){let h=data[i]*canvas.height;let x=i*w;let color='gray';if(highlights.compare&&highlights.compare.includes(i))color='red';else if(highlights.swap&&highlights.swap.includes(i))color='yellow';else if(highlights.sorted&&highlights.sorted.includes(i))color='green';else if(highlights.pivot&&highlights.pivot.includes(i))color='blue';ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.fillRect(x,canvas.height-h,w-1, h);}drawCallStack();}const highlights={compare:null,swap:null,sorted:null,pivot:null,range:null};function clearHighlights(){highlights.compare=highlights.swap=highlights.sorted=highlights.pivot=highlights.range=null;}function sleep(ms){return new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));}function scramble(pattern){if(pattern==='Random'){data=new Array(BAR_COUNT).fill(0).map(()=>Math.random());}else if(pattern==='Reverse'){data=[...Array(BAR_COUNT).keys()].reverse().map(v=>v/BAR_COUNT);}else if(pattern==='Nearly Sorted'){data=[...Array(BAR_COUNT).keys()].map(v=>v/BAR_COUNT);for(let i=0;i<BAR_COUNT/10;i++){let a=Math.floor(Math.random()*BAR_COUNT);let b=Math.floor(Math.random()*BAR_COUNT);[data[a],data[b]]=[data[b],data[a]];}}comparisons=swaps=0;clearHighlights();draw();}scrambleBtn.onclick=()=>scramble(scrambleSelect.value);algoSelect.onchange=e=>{algorithm=e.target.value;info.innerHTML='Complexity: '+complexities[algorithm];};speedSlider.oninput=e=>{speed=+e.target.value;};stepChk.onchange=e=>{stepMode=e.target.checked;nextBtn.disabled=!stepMode;};nextBtn.onclick=()=>{pauseNext=true;};function drawCallStack(){if(callDepth===0)return;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.1)';ctx.fillRect(0,0,canvas.width,20);ctx.fillStyle='black';ctx.font='12px sans-serif';ctx.fillText('Recursion depth: '+callDepth,5,15);}async function* bubbleSort(){for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){let swapped=false;for(let j=0;j<data.length-i-1;j++){highlights.compare=[j,j+1];comparisons++;yield;if(data[j]>data[j+1]){[data[j],data[j+1]]=[data[j+1],data[j]];swaps++;highlights.swap=[j,j+1];swapped=true;yield;}clearHighlights();}highlights.sorted=[data.length-i-1];if(!swapped)break;yield;}highlights.sorted=Array.from({length:data.length},(_,i)=>i);yield;}async function* quickSort(lo=0,hi=data.length-1){callDepth++;if(lo<hi){let p=await partition(lo,hi);highlights.pivot=[p];yield;yield* quickSort(lo,p-1);yield* quickSort(p+1,hi);}callDepth--;}async function partition(lo,hi){let pivot=data[hi];highlights.pivot=[hi];let i=lo;for(let j=lo;j<hi;j++){highlights.compare=[j];comparisons++;if(data[j]<pivot){[data[i],data[j]]=[data[j],data[i]];swaps++;highlights.swap=[i,j];i++;yield;clearHighlights();}}[data[i],data[hi]]=[data[hi],data[i]];swaps++;highlights.swap=[i,hi];yield;clearHighlights();return i;}async function* mergeSort(l=0,r=data.length-1){callDepth++;if(l<r){let m=Math.floor((l+r)/2);yield* mergeSort(l,m);yield* mergeSort(m+1,r);await merge(l,m,r);}}callDepth--;}async function merge(l,m,r){let left=data.slice(l,m+1);let right=data.slice(m+1,r+1);let i=0,j=0,k=l;while(i<left.length&&j<right.length){highlights.compare=[k];comparisons++;if(left[i]<=right[j]){data[k]=left[i++];}else{data[k]=right[j++];}swaps++;highlights.swap=[k];k++;yield;clearHighlights();}while(i<left.length){data[k]=left[i++];swaps++;highlights.swap=[k];k++;yield;clearHighlights();}while(j<right.length){data[k]=right[j++];swaps++;highlights=[k];k++;yield;clearHighlights();}}async function* heapSort(){callDepth++;let n=data.length;for(let i=Math.floor(n/2)-1;i>=0;i--)await heapify(n,i);for(let i=n-1;i>0;i--){[data[0],data[i]]=[data[i],data[0]];swaps++;highlights.swap=[0,i];yield;await heapify(i,0);}highlights.sorted=Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>i);yield;callDepth--;}async function heapify(n,i){callDepth++;let largest=i;let l=2*i+1;let r=2*i+2;if(l<n){highlights.compare=[l,largest];comparisons++;if(data[l]>data[largest])largest=l;}if(r<n){highlights.compare=[r,largest];comparisons++;if(data[r]>data[largest])largest=r;}if(largest!==i){[data[i],data[largest]]=[data[largest],data[i]];swaps++;highlights.swap=[i,largest];yield;await heapify(n,largest);}callDepth--;}async function* radixSort(){callDepth++;let max=Math.max(...data);for(let exp=1;Math.floor(max/exp)>0;exp*=10){await countingSort(exp);}highlights.sorted=Array.from({length:data.length},(_,i)=>i);yield;callDepth--;}async function countingSort(exp){let output=new Array(data.length).fill(0);let count=new Array(10).fill(0);for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++){let idx=Math.floor(data[i]/exp)%10;count[idx]++;}for(let i=1;i<10;i++)count[i]+=count[i-1];for(let i=data.length-1;i>=0;i--){let idx=Math.floor(data[i]/exp)%10;output[count[idx]-1]=data[i];count[idx]--; }for(let i;i<data.length;i++){if(data[i]!==output[i]){swaps++;highlights.swap=[i];}data[i]=output[i];comparisons++;yield;clearHighlights();}}function updateInfo(){info.innerHTML='Complexity: '+complexities[algorithm]+' | Comparisons: '+comparisons+' | Swaps: '+swaps; }async function run(){while(true){let gen;comparisons=swaps=0;clearHighlights();if(algorithm==='Bubble')gen=bubbleSort();else if(algorithm==='Quick')gen=quickSort();else if(algorithm==='Merge')gen=mergeSort();else if(algorithm==='Heap')gen=heapSort();else if(algorithm==='Radix')gen=radixSort();for await(let _ of gen){updateInfo();draw();if(stepMode){await new Promise(r=>{const chk=()=>{if(pauseNext){pauseNext=false;nextBtn.removeEventListener('click',chk);r();}}nextBtn.addEventListener('click',chk);});}else{await sleep(speed);} }await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));} }run();requestAnimationFrame(function loop(){draw();requestAnimationFrame(loop);});}
